name: Chat Thread Rep
description: A Replika conversation playing out bubble by bubble, with typing dots timed to each reply's word count, then leaving as a staggered wave. Renders 9:16 (1080x1920) with a transparent background. Text renders in DM Sans, a metric-matched stand-in for the licensed Pangea Text.

params.label: Conversation
params.default:
rep: hey! how did it go?
me: better than I expected
rep: I knew it would
params.description: The conversation, one message per line. Start a line with "rep:" (the companion) or "me:" (the user), or the short "r:" / "m:", to say who is speaking; unprefixed lines alternate, beginning with rep. Doubling the colon escapes it, so "me:: hi" is a message reading "me: hi". Blank lines are ignored, and a line wrapped entirely in *asterisks* is a roleplay action rendered italic. Typing dots are inserted automatically before every rep message, timed from its word count - not a parameter. Over the API the lines are joined with newlines; "|" also separates, for callers that cannot send a newline.
params.lineHint: One message per line. Start a line with "rep:" or "me:" (or "r:" / "m:") to say who is speaking; unprefixed lines alternate, beginning with rep. Typing dots are added automatically before each rep message. Wrap a whole line in *asterisks* for an action.

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: Whole-thread length, including the wave of bubbles leaving at the end: after a hold, each one plays its arrival backwards, oldest first, 0.12s apart. The pauses, typing beats and the hold stretch or compress to fit; the 240ms arrivals and the exit wave do not, since the source is explicit that a slower arrival reads as broken. Set it below the sum of those fixed parts and the clip overruns rather than rushing or clipping them.
